# Artifact Summarizer

## Purpose

Summarize a previously generated artifact into a short handoff-oriented brief.

## Use when

- A phase needs a compact digest of a long earlier output.
- Consolidated reporting needs short summaries from many artifacts.

## Rules

- Preserve all decisions from the source artifact.
- Preserve all open questions — do not drop them.
- Do not invent missing detail.
- Keep the output brief and handoff-oriented.
